question: The position of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word ‘SHIRT’ is arranged in alphabetical order?
solution:
**Given word: **SHIRT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Arranging the given word alphabetically:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63883afd3b2b6fa4d3e2c40d92634dbe27af74fb17c54ac100b31964c25477ac.png] 

This shows that only one position of one alphabet **"T"** does not change its position.**​​**

Hence, "**One**" is the correct answer.
